thread:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — can we align on the gates for SOC2 fieldwork entry? KMS/HSM integration is listed as a gating item. Need clear owners, blockers, and a minimal evidence set for the milestone in Q2 Wk2.

Raj Patel: I'll take KMS infra integration ownership (end-to-end). Ellie, can you own evidence collection for key operations? Jamie, can you own deployment attestation artifacts? @David O'Hara can you confirm HSM vendor timelines? :eyes:

David O'Hara: HSM vendor (YubiCorp) confirmed a firmware maintenance window in Wk3. Major risk: cert-rotation orchestration not finished — ETA for rotation automation ~2 weeks. We can do a manual rotation runbook in the interim.

Ellie Gomez: Draft evidence list uploaded: https://redwood.s3/links/evidence-draft (private). Short version here: access matrix, key rotation logs, KMS policy snapshots, operator onboarding checklist, audit log export samples. Need someone to sanity-check format.

Maria Chen: I can review format by EOD today. Can somebody paste the minimal checklist snippet here for quick reviews?

Jamie Park: Quick note — audit-log pipeline PR is blocking our ability to export sample logs. I've requested eng-infra review (PR #342). Pinged @eng-infra in the PR. If that doesn't merge, we'll need a manual export.

Raj Patel: Also hitting a quota/finance blocker for provisioning an HSM test cluster in us-west-2. Finance approval stuck on the contract item. @Finance-team — any update? :pray:

sec-bot: Reminder: control CC-KE1 evidence deadline in 7 days. Please tag owners on submitted artifacts to auto-index.

Ellie Gomez: Manual checklist snippet:
```
- Confirm key rotation log covers last 90 days
- Export KMS policy JSON and attach version hash
- Provide operator access matrix (roles + names)
- Provide 2 sample audit log segments (30s each)
```

David O'Hara: On vendor side — we can schedule a live attestation demo during Wk3 maintenance. That would cover some of the deployment proof items if we time it right.

Jamie Park: Action item: I will rebase the audit-log PR today and ask @eng-infra for a priority review. If merged, I'll produce the export by tomorrow. If not, I will produce a manual sample and label it 'manual-export' in the evidence bucket.

Raj Patel: Action item: I'll escalate HSM test cluster procurement to legal and finance leads this afternoon and post status here.

Maria Chen: Recap of owners & blockers:
- KMS infra + integration: Raj Patel (blocker: HSM test cluster procurement)
- Evidence collection (keys & logs): Ellie Gomez (blocker: repo permissions + format review)
- Deployment attestation/proofs: Jamie Park (blocker: audit-log PR merge)
- HSM vendor timeline & attestation: David O'Hara (blocker: firmware window scheduling)

Maria Chen: Please respond with short ack or update by EOD. We'll retag for a quick async readout tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:

Ellie Gomez: Ack — will upload formatted evidence by EOD and tag owners.

Raj Patel: Ack — will post procurement update here after escalation.

Jamie Park: Ack — targeting PR merge today, will update thread.

David O'Hara: Ack — will confirm vendor window and propose demo slot.
